The doctors and nurses are excellent - our GP spotted a rare illness early, saving us from serious problems. The level of care has always been top-notch.

Reception staff work incredibly hard and are always helpful. I had a dispute with them when the pharmacy misplaced my medication but they sorted it and it wasn't their fault.

Appointments used to be tricky to book by phone, but the automated system has made it much easier (normally hate these but here it works ad is valuable).

Parking is limited, but there are good walking routes and plenty of disabled bays. Every time I need to get a prescription there are delays or problems with the pharmacy receiving it from Mill Lane.

For example, I recently phoned Mill Lane asking for a repeat prescription. The receptionist advised I needed to fill out the online form and confirmed it would be ready to pick up from the pharmacy in four days. Not ideal, as I was about to run out of the medication, but it may have been slower as the process would fall over the weekend. I completed the form straight away and turned up at the pharmacy on the day I'd been advised to. The pharmacy checked and they had not received the prescription. I phoned Mill Lane to find out what the problem was, and spoke to what sounded like the same receptionist. She said the prescription had still not even been signed by the doctor after four days of waiting. When I asked how much longer it would take for them to do this and send the prescription to the pharmacy, she said another two days. I received absolutely no apology or explanation for the delay, poor communication and waste of my time. Really disappointing and frustrating, as I had run out of medication which I rely on due to the practice's delays.

Terrible customer service experience, but not at all surprising given my previous experiences with Mill Lane.",null,[0,127]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJdWMzYmxnRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x638d82d977417aad!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgMDIuc3blgE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJdWMzYmxnRRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJdWMzYmxnRRItChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTURJdWMzYlZnEhNDZ3dJeElma3Z3WVEtSl9zM0FFGi0KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdNREl1YzNiMWdFEhJDZ3NJOUlYa3Z3WVEwTV9nU0EiEgkAAAAAAAAAABGtekF32YKNYyoTQ2d3SXhJZmt2d1lRLUpfczNBRQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi_1YPMna-TAxU7MGMBHYKIGEIQoykIECgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwi_1YPMna-TAxU7MGMBHYKIGEIQ0pMFCA4oBA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUpOYzNOZlgxOWZSV2hDVERodFVuUnVNR1F6YTE5eVRWRk9VVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpoYjBOaFpIUktVMHBCV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ3eGQyalZnEAE",["0x0:0x638d82d977417aad",null,1724670321646201,1741162062067808,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/117419103378481288377/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Eve R","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjX4gn2Y6SEO6pX0QWs0JqmEWM2lRw2f6iZM8tCY17OV4ja9AfbwhA=s120-c-rp-mo-ba4-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/117419103378481288377?hl=en"],"117419103378481288377",null,80,33,null,[1,6,1],8,["Local Guide · 80 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi_1YPMna-TAxU7MGMBHYKIGEIQ7LoGCBIoAA"]]]],null,"Edited a year ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[4],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Edit: As of March 2025, the practice has now implemented a queue system on the phone line, meaning I only needed to call once before speaking to the receptionist. As a result, I’ve adjusted my star rating.

--------

I am very disappointed with this GP practice. I attempted to book my three-week-old son's six-week appointment, only to be told that I need to call back tomorrow because all the doctors are fully booked. Despite explaining that I wasn't looking for an appointment today but one in three weeks' time, I was informed that this makes no difference. It seems that I cannot book a mandatory appointment in advance.

Another major issue with this practice is the lack of a phone waiting system. On a previous occasion, when I needed to book an appointment, the phone line was constantly engaged. I had to redial 96 times before I finally got through. My midwife has been excellent, so I have no complaints there. However, the phone system is seriously flawed, and I will be seeking a new GP practice.",null,[0,205]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ3eGQyalZnEAE!2m1!1s0x0:0x638d82d977417aad!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgID7xd2jVg%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ3eGQyalZnEAE&t=1&entityid=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUQ3eGQyalZnEi0KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJRDd4ZDJqMWdFEhJDZ3NJem95Z3ZnWVFnTmFxSUEaLQoWQ0lITTBvZ0tFSUNBZ0lEN3hkMmpOZxITQ2d3SXVveWd2Z1lROEtLbXdnSSISCQAAAAAAAAAAEa16QXfZgo1jKhJDZ3NJem95Z3ZnWVFnTmFxSUE&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi_1YPMna-TAxU7MGMBHYKIGEIQoykIEygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwi_1YPMna-TAxU7MGMBHYKIGEIQ0pMFCBEoBQ"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCaHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUpuWVRaZlgxOWZSV2hEZUdFNE5rTmpRMnQxT1VKalYwWlhhMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEprYjBOaGNIRnVXSGQzV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNIZ08ycWhRRRAB",["0x0:0x638d82d977417aad",null,1725035382644331,1725035382644331,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107651423066931553927/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Sheri","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWcx1wI3QDvHeLT2ivRDlrIcsHX6Vz5z_llJoYeIT0uhErKJWkY=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107651423066931553927?hl=en"],"107651423066931553927",null,5,2,null,[0,3,1],4,["5 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi_1YPMna-TAxU7MGMBHYKIGEIQ7LoGCBUoAA"]]]],null,"a year ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Mill Lane has been a deeply frustrating experience for me, starting with their appointment system. They only offer emergency appointments, requiring you to call the same day at 8 a.m. It often takes nearly 100 calls just to get through, which is incredibly stressful and inconvenient not to be able to schedule future appointments.

Once you do get an appointment, the experience doesn’t improve. My interactions with the reception staff have been particularly negative. I had a scheduled phone consultation, but when my phone didn’t ring and I missed the calls, I called back immediately. The receptionist in training put me on hold multiple times, only to tell me that my test results were "ok," and there was no need to speak with the GP. When I insisted on speaking to the doctor, the manager got involved and scolded me for missing the call, treating me as if I were a child being late to school. Frustrated, I went to the practice in person to pick up my results. To make matters worse, the receptionist smiled and told me I would be receiving a warning letter for raising my voice. This made me feel trapped and disrespected. As a medical receptionist myself, I understand how important empathy and respect are in patient care—qualities that were sorely lacking here.

My experiences with the GP were equally unsettling. During my first appointment, she made me feel like I was lying about my epilepsy, sighing at the medications I was on until I showed her my past doctor’s notes. On another visit, she described a muscle issue I had as "weird," which left me feeling small and as if something was wrong with me.

Overall, I strongly advise against visiting this practice due to the consistent lack of care and respect I experienced.",null,[0,236]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNIZ08ycWhRRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x638d82d977417aad!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgICHgO2qhQE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNIZ08ycWhRRRAB&t=1&entityid=ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNIZ08ycWhRRRItChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNIZ08ycVJREhNDZ3dJOXViSHRnWVEtT3Vlc3dJGi4KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJQ0hnTzJxeFFFEhNDZ3dJOXViSHRnWVEtT3Vlc3dJIhIJAAAAAAAAAAARrXpBd9mCjWMqE0Nnd0k5dWJIdGdZUS1PdWVzd0k&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi_1YPMna-TAxU7MGMBHYKIGEIQoykIFigB"],null,[null,[[1,3]]]],"0ahUKEwi_1YPMna-TAxU7MGMBHYKIGEIQ0pMFCBQoBg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURU5NWjNkZlgxOWZSV2hDV1dJdGJYZEtjbGxJZDI4d2JuaEVORUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpyVVVOaWJIWm5MVWx6V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR6cy11Tjl3RRAB",["0x0:0x638d82d977417aad",null,1718180494619918,1718180494619918,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113785809877524411696/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Alice C","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjUfL5Tf2PRSgrQs2kEn6l2WQ9FV7muBSVJAEHSv5WjJ6aO2Ii9mWw=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/113785809877524411696?hl=en"],"113785809877524411696",null,9,2,null,[0,3,1],1,["9 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi_1YPMna-TAxU7MGMBHYKIGEIQ7LoGCBgoAA"]]]],null,"a year ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["This morning I have called 30 times since 8am to make an appointment. The call either rings a bit then goes dead or you get a dial tone due to too many people are calling and no one is getting through.
